clipCandidates.momentLabel: No blue pigment — color made by structure
clipCandidates.why: Mind-blowing opening — peacock feathers have zero blue pigment. Color is entirely structural. Instant curiosity gap.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: This peacock feather has no blue in it at all — and the proof is in how it changes when you move

clipCandidates.momentLabel: Same feather reflects different colors at different angles
clipCandidates.why: Visual demonstration of the superpower — look straight on it's blue, tilt your head and it's green, then bronze, then purple. Photonic crystals shifting with viewing angle.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: Watch this feather change from blue to green to purple — without any pigment at all

Why the Elephant Cools Itself With Its Ears #Shorts

comments.author: @princessdaisy5321
comments.text: Elephant is so social the mothers and kids create a safe herd for all members. Poor working elephant is abused, depressed, lonely and owners don't care about physical needs or emotions
comments.replyText: You're absolutely right that elephants are deeply social and emotional animals. The matriarch-led herds are incredible to study — they grieve, celebrate, and protect each other. All footage in this Short is from sanctuaries and wild habitats. Thanks for caring about these amazing animals

clipCandidates.momentLabel: Elephants can't sweat — ears are giant radiators
clipCandidates.why: Surprising fact — elephants have almost no sweat glands. On 50°C savanna that should kill them. But ears are giant radiators packed with capillaries.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: Elephants can't sweat — so they cool their entire body using just their ears

clipCandidates.momentLabel: Blood drops 5 degrees in a single pass through ears
clipCandidates.why: Quantified superpower — air across ear capillary network cools blood by 10 degrees, blood in ears drops 5 degrees in single pass. African elephant ears 3x Asian elephants.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: This elephant's blood drops 5 degrees every time it passes through its ears

clipCandidates.momentLabel: Returns to exact birth beach 20-30 years later
clipCandidates.why: Incredible journey — hatches on beach, disappears into ocean, returns 20-30 years later to within miles of exact spot. Without landmarks, without a map.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: This turtle returns to the exact beach it was born on — 30 years and 10000 miles later

clipCandidates.momentLabel: Scientists proved turtles navigate by magnetism alone
clipCandidates.why: Scientific proof — researchers simulated magnetic fields in pools and turtles turned in exact direction they would travel. Navigating by magnetism alone, no map, no compass.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: Scientists put turtles in pools and proved they navigate by reading the planet's magnetic field
